description: Machine-tools; (including presses) for working metal by forging, hammering or die-forging, for bending, folding, straightening, flattening, shearing, punching, notching or nibbling metal, n.e.c. in heading 8462

predecessors.note: Before 2022 other metal forming machines of heading 8462 were reported largely inside HS 846299. The continuous long series is at HS-4 8462.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
